key_policy: Choice key = natural 1-5 word English name of the label, fixed for every split, variant and model (DESIGN field rule 2, D8). Descriptions (D_*) and propositions (P_*) are authored separately per pool and never live in this file.
label_id_type: raw_value (int as string; names from the dataset card: LABEL_0 Bearish, LABEL_1 Bullish, LABEL_2 Neutral)
